cds.title: University of Utah Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

cost.notes: First-year full-time costs as printed in G1/G5 of the 2025-26 Common Data Set (15 credits per term, headed 2026-27): in-state tuition $10,080, nonresident tuition $35,282, required fees $1,086, on-campus food and housing $15,537 (housing $8,395 + meal plan $7,142), books $1,600; 'other' = transportation $2,600 + other expenses $12,000. Utah's financial aid office publishes a different 2026-27 budget (tuition and fees $10,480 resident / $32,932 nonresident; on-campus nonresident total $68,330), and the international admissions page estimates $66,105 total expenses for an I-20 (tuition and fees $32,932, international student fee $300, orientation fee $75, living $32,798), so expect the real bill to differ from the CDS figures. CDS H6 ticks both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid for nonresidents and reports 776 undergraduate nonresidents aided at an average $10,340 (total $8,024,213), but the admissions FAQ says international students on a visa are not considered for merit or need-based University of Utah scholarships.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 30,036 applied, 27,076 admitted, 6,513 enrolled; the in-state / out-of-state / international rows (10,063 + 18,977 + 996 applied; 9,028 + 17,153 + 895 admitted; 3,210 + 3,061 + 242 enrolled) and the men / women rows add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 996 applied, 895 admitted, 242 enrolled. No early decision; nonbinding early action (closing Dec 1). No waitlist (CDS C2: no policy of placing students on a waiting list). GPA breakdown is for all enrolled first-year students (98% reported a GPA). SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-years who submitted scores (14% SAT, 36% ACT); Utah is test optional. Undergraduate enrollment (29,335) and the nonresident count (1,738) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures in B1/B2.
